about: What the voice says for Explorer Harbor beside the lines of its pack: the line each picture of a story is told with, and everything said in the room for making a story. Written by scripts/content/explorer-harbor.mjs from the storybook and from storymaker.json; do not edit by hand.

lines.eh.panel.seed1: A seed sleeps in the soil.
lines.eh.panel.egg1: The hen sits on her egg.
lines.eh.panel.snow1: We roll two balls of snow.
lines.eh.panel.tower2: The blocks make a tall tower.
lines.eh.panel.castle1: Here is sand, and a bucket.
lines.eh.make.who: Let us make a story. Who is it about?
lines.eh.make.trouble: Oh dear. Something goes wrong. What is it?
lines.eh.make.told: Here is your story, from the beginning.
lines.eh.make.whole: That is your story. You can hear it again, or make a new one.

lines.eh.make.but.kite.no-wind: But the wind stopped, and the kite fell down.
lines.eh.make.so.kite.no-wind.run: So it was time to run! Along the sand, as fast as the wind, and up went the kite.
lines.eh.make.so.kite.no-wind.wait: So there was nothing to do but wait. Then the wind came back, and up went the kite.
lines.eh.make.but.kite.tangle: But the string was all in a tangle.
lines.eh.make.so.kite.tangle.crab: Along came a little crab. Snip, snip, and the knots were gone. Up went the kite.
lines.eh.make.so.kite.tangle.slowly: Slowly, slowly, one knot at a time, the string came free. Up went the kite.
lines.eh.make.but.sandcastle.wave: But a big wave came, and washed the castle away.
lines.eh.make.so.sandcastle.wave.higher: So a new castle was built, high up the beach, where no wave could reach.
lines.eh.make.so.sandcastle.wave.ditch: So a ditch was dug all round a new castle. The next wave filled the ditch, and the castle stood.
lines.eh.make.but.sandcastle.dry: But the sand was too dry, and the castle fell down.
lines.eh.make.so.sandcastle.dry.bucket: A bucket of sea water made the sand wet, and the new castle stood up tall.
lines.eh.make.so.sandcastle.dry.dig: Deep down, the sand was wet. That sand made a castle that stood up tall.
lines.eh.make.but.berries.high: But the best berries were too high to reach.
lines.eh.make.so.berries.high.log: So a log was rolled under the bush. One step up, and the basket was full.
lines.eh.make.so.berries.high.stick: A long stick pulled the branch down low, and soon the basket was full.
lines.eh.make.but.berries.hole: But the basket had a hole, and the berries fell out.
lines.eh.make.so.berries.hole.leaf: A big leaf went into the basket, over the hole. Not one more berry fell out.
lines.eh.make.so.berries.hole.eat: So the berries were eaten then and there. Yum, yum, yum!
lines.eh.make.but.stream.broken: But the little bridge was broken.
lines.eh.make.so.stream.broken.stones: Three flat stones lay in the water. Step, step, step, and over the stream.
lines.eh.make.so.stream.broken.log: A fallen log lay near. Pushed across the water, it made a new bridge.
lines.eh.make.but.stream.deep: But the water was too deep to walk across.
lines.eh.make.so.stream.deep.along: A little way along, it was not deep at all. Splash, splash, and over the stream.
lines.eh.make.so.stream.deep.boat: A little boat was tied to a tree. Row, row, row, and over the stream.
lines.eh.make.but.picnic.rain: But then it began to rain.
lines.eh.make.so.picnic.rain.tree: Under the big tree it was dry. The picnic was eaten there, to the sound of the rain.
lines.eh.make.so.picnic.rain.umbrella: Up went a big umbrella, and the picnic stayed dry.
lines.eh.make.but.picnic.ants: But a line of ants came marching for the cake.
lines.eh.make.so.picnic.ants.share: So every ant was given a crumb, and there was plenty of cake for all.
lines.eh.make.so.picnic.ants.move: So the picnic was moved to the top of the hill, and the ants went home.
lines.eh.make.but.apple.high: But the apple was much too high to reach.
lines.eh.make.so.apple.high.ladder: A ladder stood by the shed. Up, up, up, and the apple was picked.
lines.eh.make.so.apple.high.shake: One gentle shake of the tree, and down came the apple, plop, into the grass.
lines.eh.make.but.apple.rolled: But the apple fell, and rolled away down the hill.
lines.eh.make.so.apple.rolled.chase: After it! Down the hill and round the pond, and there was the apple, by the gate.
lines.eh.make.so.apple.rolled.duck: It rolled all the way to the pond. A duck pushed it back to the bank with its beak.
